name: TMKB 60% Hall Effect Magnetic Mechanical Gaming Keyboard, 8K Hz, Web Driver No App, Rapid Trigger, Adjustable Actuation, RGB Balcklit, Wired Keyboard for PC Laptop Gamer, Black
description:
0.02mm Rapid Trigger for FPS Precision: Dominate in competitive tactical shooters with the T68-C HE's advanced Rapid Trigger technology. Unlike traditional switches, our Hall Effect sensors reset instantly, allowing for 0.02mm adjustable actuation. Achieve pixel-perfect counter-strafing and faster peeking, giving you a tangible advantage in high-stakes esports matches.

True 8000Hz Polling & <0.3ms Latency: Experience the pinnacle of esports speed. While others lag at 1000Hz, the T68-C transmits data 8x faster, achieving near-zero latency (<0.3ms). Whether it's rapid-fire spamming or complex movement tech, your inputs are registered with raw, unfiltered speed, ensuring your hardware keeps up with your reaction time.

No Downloads - Innovative Web-Based Driver: Forget heavy software that slows down your PC. Our browser-based hub (Chrome/Edge compatible) allows you to customize actuation points, Rapid Trigger sensitivity, and RGB lighting on the fly. It's the perfect tournament-ready solution with onboard memory for up to 4 profiles.

Compact 68-Key Layout & Double-Shot Keycaps: Maximize your desk space for wide mouse swipes while keeping dedicated arrow keys. The T68-C features high-quality Double-Shot Injection keycaps, engineered for superior light transmission and vibrant RGB effects. The legends are molded into the keycap, so they will never wear off even after years of intense gaming.

100 Million Keystroke Durability: Built for the "Endgame." The non-contact magnetic sensors eliminate physical friction, extending switch life to 100 million presses. Enjoy a smooth, linear feel that stays consistent from day one. Factory-lubed stabilizers ensure a solid, premium typing experience for both pro gamers and enthusiasts.
